policy.rule: Ceiling = measured + 2 % per surface and metric. A ceiling moves up only through `--resample --reason`, which appends to history; after a reclaim, resample so the ceiling moves down. Two-byte (non-Latin-1) chunk counts get no headroom. Renderer surfaces gate raw, gzip-9 and brotli-11; Preload and Node surfaces gate raw (resident source); their gzip and brotli are recorded under `measured` for information only and have no ceiling. Preload and Node surfaces gate the production build only (the bytes that ship); any other flavour prints its deltas against the same ceilings without failing. Ceilings are sampled only from a production build, and `pnpm budget:production` builds with production inputs whatever the shell or CI says.
